links.evidence: Boardwalk Pipeline accounted for 10.0%, 9.3% and 8.6% of our consolidated total revenue for the years ended December 31, 2016, 2015 and 2014.
Dell Inc. (Dell) accounted for 16% of our net revenue (15% in 2013 and 14% in 2012)
We manufacture 105 to 430 horsepower diesel engines, including engines for the pick-up truck market for Stellantis N.V. (Stellantis) in North America and LCV markets in Latin America and China.
We announced an agreement with Nissan Motor Co. Ltd. in 2013 to supply our light-duty diesel engine and began commercial shipment in 2015.
The Company's equity method investments include, but are not limited to, our ownership interests in Coca-Cola European Partners plc ("CCEP")
Our competitors include but are not limited to: • Maxim Integrated Products, Inc.
